utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane — I’m happy to help with the book club. What are you thinking for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara — sorry I’m late. I was thinking we could pick something short and easy to discuss, maybe a mystery or a memoir.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great — a short mystery or memoir would be easy to get through and talk about. If you want, I can suggest a few options and we can pick one together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the book club reading next?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the list before I answer — I want to make sure I get the next book right.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No rush — just let me know when you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t heard any book club updates yet—what are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—sorry, I missed the latest note. I think we’re still deciding, but I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Noah — I’d appreciate that. If you see any supply needs for the meeting too, let me know and I can keep track.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still deciding if I’ll join the book club, but I’m curious what you all are reading next.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We’re picking the next book at Tuesday’s meeting, and I can let you know once we settle on it. If you’re curious, you’re welcome to come by and see how it goes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — I’d like that. If I can make it on Tuesday, I’ll stop by and see what you all choose.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting on Thursday for book club?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard otherwise, so I think Thursday is still on. If you want, I can check with someone else too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — could you check and let me know if anything changes?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club’s been buzzing lately — I heard we’re picking something cozy this month, maybe with a little mystery mixed in. Have you heard what everyone’s leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t heard the final pick yet, but cozy with a little mystery sounds just right to me. If you want, I can bring by a few good suggestions from my shelf.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be lovely, Gus — bring your best shelf picks and we’ll see if the club bites. I’ve got a feeling the room’s leaning toward something warm, a bit twisty, and easy to chat about.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, book club? I’d love that—mind if I tell a few neighbors too? I can spread the word fast.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—please do. I’m at 214 Maple, and I’ll be there Thursday at 7 if anyone wants to join.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll let folks know about 214 Maple this Thursday at 7. Looking forward to it!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — what are we reading for book club?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we picking one book for everyone or voting on a few options?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d suggest we vote on a few options first, then pick one book for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m excited to help with the book club. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hi Rosa — let’s pick the first book and set a date.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ll suggest a few good first-book options, and we can choose a date that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the plan to the book club folks and we can all check in next week.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me, Vik. I’ll look forward to the check-in next week.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll pass it along and we’ll touch base next week.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the book club. I’m blanking on the title again, but I’m happy to come along if you’re still going.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course, you’re still welcome. I’ll send you the title before we meet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, thanks, Uli — that would help a lot. I’ll keep an eye out for it and I’m looking forward to it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d love to hear what the book club’s reading next—anything good on the list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh yeah, I heard there’s a really good one coming up—something folks have been talking about a lot. I’ll grab the title for you next time I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Nice, thanks — I’m curious what all the buzz is about. Just let me know when you get the title!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, book club? Count me in — I can already think of a few neighbors who’d love it too!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, Quinn — I’ll be late as usual, but I’m definitely in too. Let’s bring a few good books and make it fun.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll spread the word around the block and see who else wants to join. We’ll make it a lively one!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still getting a feel for the book club, but it sounds nice. What are you all reading next?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re starting a short mystery next Tuesday, same time as usual. If you’d like, I can bring you the title and a little summary before then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thanks. I’d like to know a little about it before Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check our school schedule and see when I’m free for book club.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — that’d be super helpful. Just let me know what you find, and we’ll pick a good time for book club.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll look after school pickup and the kids’ activities, then I’ll send you a few open times for book club.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik — I was thinking the book club could be a nice way to get everyone talking, especially if we pick something easy to jump into.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, that sounds good — I can mention that idea to everyone and help keep it simple. Maybe we should pick something short and friendly first so people can jump in easily.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds perfect — maybe a short, warm read with room for everyone to chime in. If you want, I can suggest a few easy picks and you can float them to the group.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia, happy to help with the book club—what do you need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — I’m just trying to sort out the details. Do you know if we still need a room booked and who’s bringing the books?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure yet, but I can check on the room booking and ask around about the books. If you want, I can also help make a quick list of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the book club notes yet—do you know where it’s meeting this week?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I can check that for you—if the notes are the same as last week, we’re usually at the community center on Thursday evening.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds right—I'll head to the community center Thursday evening unless you hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still meeting at the library on Thursday, and should I bring snacks?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still meeting at the library on Thursday. And snacks would be great—could you bring something simple?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, I’ll bring something simple. Do you want sweet or savory?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — what are we picking for the book club next?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the supplies, and for book club I’d vote for something everyone can get into—maybe a mystery or a short novel.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds like a great call — a mystery would keep it fun, and a short novel makes it easier for everyone to join in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits about the book club, but it sounds like people are enjoying it. What book are they reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—book club. I think they’re reading something about a small-town mystery, but I may be mixing it up with last month’s pick.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds like the kind of thing they’d pick. If you hear the title for sure, let me know—I’m curious what everyone’s reading.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are we actually doing the book club this week, or is that still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it’s still a little up in the air, but I’d lean yes unless someone cancels last minute. I’ll try to find out and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — please do, and let me know as soon as you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice—how’s the book club going these days?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s going alright, thanks for asking. I’ve been a bit quiet lately, but I still enjoy the meetings.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear—sometimes just listening is enough. Have you read anything lately you’d recommend?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club—I'm still a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help. What’s the plan for this week?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re meeting Thursday at 7 at my place—just bring the book and we’ll keep it simple. I’ll send the title and a reminder later today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks Leo — I’ll keep Thursday at 7 open and bring the book when you send the title. Appreciate the reminder, because my memory’s a bit mushy these days!
